menu.name: shown
menu.formula: filter(items, i => i.tab == tab && (trim(query) == '' || contains(lower(i.name + ' ' + i.description), lower(trim(query)))) && all(filters, f => contains(i.tags, f)))

menu.name: countLabel
menu.formula: length(shown) + (length(shown) == 1 ? ' ITEM' : ' ITEMS') + (activeCount > 0 ? ' MATCHING YOUR CHOICES' : ' ON THIS MENU')
